scenario.title: What a QA result proves
situations: An item has checks before merge and acceptance after delivery.
One release contains several items and a run-wide check.
A user runs a saved plan without an item.
Evidence exists for a different environment or candidate.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Subject and target contracts/read surfaces inspected; delivery admission and machine configuration are other auditors scopes, not re-proven here.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.

lessons.title: Bind evidence to the obligation
lessons.when: When attaching QA to a workflow transition or composing item-scoped versus run-wide release QA.
lessons.need: A requirement belongs to an item/task or a deployment run, optionally a stage and member. Item acceptance and run-wide QA are separate; candidate, phase and target matter.
lessons.surface: Case attachment validation; Shipping Item QA/Run QA; QA subject reads
lessons.gap: Review question: should the first mixed release show a small explanation of item-versus-run QA, with detailed binding rules fetched by the agent?

lessons.title: Standalone testing does not close unrelated gates
lessons.when: When the user asks to run a saved plan now without an item or deployment-run subject.
lessons.need: A standalone plan execution freezes its own roster and owns its evidence. It changes no item transition or release acceptance; an unrelated green result is not substitute proof.
lessons.surface: Standalone plan run help/reference; plan detail outcome
lessons.gap: Review question: should QA Plans offer distinct explanatory routes for test now and require this for work, before the agent selects scope?

lessons.title: Use the requested target and actual identity
lessons.when: Before execution or evidence acceptance, when candidate/environment/phase can differ from existing proof.
lessons.need: Select phase by the obligation, not the URL name. Read the bound candidate/environment; Stage proof cannot stand in for Production and an earlier candidate cannot prove a later one.
lessons.surface: Intake attachment; bound target refusals; standalone environment obligations
lessons.gap: Review question: should evidence summaries lead with what was checked, where and against which candidate, before implementation identifiers?
